bluf: BBC News and The Record reported fake nuclear warnings after emergency alert apps in Ukraine and Russia were hacked; BBC News said neither government had confirmed responsibility. Iran said it was holding intensive indirect talks with Washington to avoid a fresh round of US attacks, according to France 24.

cyber.text: BleepingComputer reported that more than 1,000 internet-exposed GitLab servers remained unpatched against a flaw being actively exploited in remote-code-execution attacks.
BleepingComputer reported that Ivanti released updates for two more Connect Secure flaws that had been chained in zero-day attacks since at least October 1.
